card.name: Post before exposure or treatment terms
card.fires_on: The word post (or Post) right before a hyphen or joined term such as post-exposure, post-HSCT or Posttreatment. It also fires on a few short linking words like per and of in dosing and metabolism phrases.

modes.label: Post- prefix
modes.description: The word post starts a compound about time after exposure, transplant or treatment.
modes.example: the treatment of inhalational anthrax (<<post>>-exposure) the recommended dose is

modes.label: Short linking words
modes.description: A short word like per or of sits inside a dosing or metabolism phrase.
modes.example: at a reduced dose of 0.7 mg/m 2<< per>> injection during the first cycle, and consider
